archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) mixed with Archetype 4 (Swiss/Soft Utility) for an Apple-style corporate tone.
design_philosophy: A trustworthy, corporate, yet highly modern and simple Apple-style UI. Generous spacing, soft borders, crisp typography, and an organic warmth created by the emerald and warm beige palette. The fixed dark sidebar provides a structural anchor, while the white content area feels breathable and clear.

typography.instructions: Import 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts. Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8 for cards to prevent content collision.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use the 'Control Room' grid for the dashboard. gap-6 between cards. Mobile-first (grid-cols-1) scaling up to md:grid-cols-2 or lg:grid-cols-3/4 based on content.

sidebar.layout: Fixed left, w-72, h-screen. Dark slate background (#0F172A).
sidebar.items: 12 items. Use lucide-react icons. Active state should have a subtle emerald-600 indicator (like a left border or pill background) or bg-slate-800.

promo_banner.layout: Sticky or fixed top, z-50, w-full, h-10 to h-12. Background #FACC15.
promo_banner.text: text-sm font-bold text-yellow-900 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
promo_banner.animation: Optional subtle marquee or simple bold centered text.

content_area.layout: ml-0 lg:ml-72 mt-10 (below banner). bg-[#F5E6D3] min-h-screen p-4 sm:p-8.

cards.style: bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 or p-8 border border-black/5. Neumorphic 'Clay & Crisp' approach - flat background with subtle border and ultra-soft shadow.

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold hover:bg-emerald-700 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors

tables.style: Clean, Apple-style. No vertical borders. Light horizontal dividers (border-slate-100). text-sm. Header text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 bg-slate-50/50 rounded-t-xl.

user_avatar.usage: Top right profile icon or sidebar profile section.

course_thumbnail_1.usage: Featured course or Last watched video thumbnail.

generic_thumbnail_1.usage: Supervision Education cards or secondary course covers.

generic_thumbnail_2.usage: Live streams background or alternative card graphics.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.
Implement the Layout with a fixed sidebar (left) and main content area (right). Make it responsive: sidebar should be a drawer/hamburger on mobile.
Include a global sticky Yellow Promo Banner at the absolute top.
Apply background color #F5E6D3 to the main content area wrapper, and pure white (#FFFFFF) to the data cards.
Inject 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts into index.html from Google Fonts and set them up in tailwind.config.js.
Use standard semantic HTML augmented with Tailwind for complex card layouts instead of restricting to generic Shadcn Card if you need bespoke Apple-style overlapping or layouts.
Implement the 12 required sidebar items exactly as listed in the problem statement.
Create the required dashboard sections: Education progress, My Files, Payments, Contracts, Exams, Certificates, Transcript, Live Streams/Calendar, Supervision/Calendar.
Utilize the provided image URLs strictly. DO NOT use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and form inputs for testing.
